name: account-review-dashboard
description: Account-review dashboard generated from the TypeSpec-backed mcp_dashboards dataset contract.

scripts.dev: node scripts/build-hosts.mjs preview && DASHBOARD_MODE=preview astro dev
scripts.dev:live-local: node scripts/build-hosts.mjs live-local && DASHBOARD_MODE=live-local astro dev
scripts.build:live: node scripts/build-hosts.mjs live && DASHBOARD_MODE=live astro build --outDir dist/live
scripts.build:preview: npm run mock:data && node scripts/build-hosts.mjs preview && DASHBOARD_MODE=preview astro build --outDir dist/preview
scripts.build:live-local: node scripts/build-hosts.mjs live-local && DASHBOARD_MODE=live-local astro build --outDir dist/live-local
scripts.build: npm run build:live && npm run build:preview
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run verify
